turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my coffee machine is leaking again. Any quick fixes?
Hi Alan. Try checking the O-ring on the group head first. If it's dry or cracked, replacing it usually stops the leak. Do you have a spare part handy?
No, I'll have to order one. Speaking of orders, did that package for the lab arrive?
Let me check the status... Yes, the tracking shows it was delivered yesterday. It should be in your inbox.
Great. I'm actually reviewing the benchmarks for that new model. GigaWorld-Policy is 9 times faster than Motus.
That's a significant speedup. Have you looked into the resource usage as well?
Not yet. I need to go, the leak is getting worse. Thanks.
Good luck with the plumbing! Talk soon.
Lloyd, are you free for lunch suggestions? I'm craving Thai.
Sure! How about 'Bangkok Garden' on 5th? They have good reviews for their Pad See Ew.
Sounds good. I might invite Sarah from the robotics team.
She might be busy with the hardware setup. Did you manage to test the new policy model yet?
We did some preliminary runs. GigaWorld-Policy outperforms π-0.5 on real-world robotic platforms.
That's promising for the deployment timeline. Real-world performance is often the bottleneck.
Exactly. Anyway, book us a table for 12:30?
Done. I'll add Sarah to the reservation as well.
